post.description: Sign in; unknown email, wrong password, and disabled user look alike.
Revoke the current session if there is one; 204 either way.
Create an account and sign it in.

Summarize posted readings and events over a window. Stores nothing.

Stages run in a fixed order and the first failure answers: schema,
duplicate ids, mapping, timestamp conflicts, then computation (AC-5a).

patch.description: Change the label and/or register digits of an active meter.

post.description: Terminal: a replacement physical meter gets a new meter (ADR-006).

delete.description: Soft delete: the property, its meters, and their data become 404.

patch.description:
Change any of nickname, region (null clears it), and timezone.

Changing the timezone never alters stored readings.

get.description: Report that the process is serving requests, and its version.
Report ready when the database answers and its schema is at head.
